description: Snapshot of a destination: hotel counts, average Comfort Score, median price, where its hotels beat and trail the average hotel, the best neighbourhoods, and which travel styles it suits. Use it when the user is choosing a destination or an area; for a request for hotels (e.g. 'quiet hotels in Bangkok'), call search_hotels directly.

checkin.description: User's check-in date, YYYY-MM-DD, if given: links then open on this stay.

name: get_city_overview
